step1_analysis.description: Downconverts an RF signal to an IF or baseband frequency using a local oscillator (LO). It consists of a differential transconductance stage for the RF input, a switching quad for the LO, and a passive RC load.

conversion_gain.description: Voltage conversion gain from the RF input to the IF output.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the tail current, degeneration resistor (RE), and load resistor (RL). Adjusted for 1.8V headroom in SKY130.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the mixer core.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical power budget for a single mixer stage in a receiver front-end.

if_bandwidth.description: 3dB bandwidth of the IF output port.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the RC time constant of the load. 159 MHz is more than sufficient for DVB-T baseband/IF.

step3_testbench.description: Measures conversion gain and power consumption using a transient analysis with a 10 MHz IF, and measures IF bandwidth using an AC analysis by unbalancing the LO quad.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Gilbert Cell Mixer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_rf=50 L_rf=0.15
.param W_lo=20 L_lo=0.15
.param RL=500 RE=10 CL=2p I_tail=2m

* DUT
X1 N1 Vin N3 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_rf} l={L_rf}
X2 N2 Vinb N4 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_rf} l={L_rf}
X3 Vob LO N1 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_lo} l={L_lo}
X4 Vo LOb N1 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_lo} l={L_lo}
X5 Vob LOb N2 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_lo} l={L_lo}
X6 Vo LO N2 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_lo} l={L_lo}

R1 VCC Vob {RL}
R2 VCC Vo {RL}
R3 N4 N5 {RE}
R4 N3 N5 {RE}
C1 Vo VCC {CL}
C2 Vob VCC {CL}
I1 N5 VEE {I_tail}

* Supplies
VVCC VCC 0 DC 1.8
VVEE VEE 0 DC 0

* RF Inputs (930 MHz, 10mV peak per side)
VRF Vin 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.01 930MEG 0 0 0)
VRFB Vinb 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 180 SIN(0.9 0.01 930MEG 0 0 180)

* LO Inputs (920 MHz, 300mV peak per side)
VLO LO 0 DC 1.3 SIN(1.3 0.3 920MEG 0 0 0)
VLOB LOb 0 DC 1.3 SIN(1.3 0.3 920MEG 0 0 180)

* Differential Output Calculation
B1 Vdiff 0 V=v(Vo)-v(Vob)

.control
* 1. Transient Analysis for Conversion Gain and Power
* IF is 10 MHz (Period = 100ns). Run for 300ns, measure last 100ns.
tran 10p 300n
meas tran vout_max max v(Vdiff) from=200n to=300n
meas tran vout_min min v(Vdiff) from=200n to=300n
let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
* Input RF is 20mV peak-to-peak differential
let conv_gain = vout_pp / 0.02
let conv_gain_db = 20 * log10(conv_gain)
print conv_gain_db

meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVCC) from=200n to=300n
let power = -pwr_avg * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis for IF Bandwidth
* Unbalance the LO to make the mixer act as a cascode amplifier
alter VLO dc = 1.8
alter VLOB dc = 0
ac dec 10 1Meg 10Gig
let gain_ac = vdb(Vdiff)
meas ac max_gain max gain_ac
let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_ac=gain_3db fall=1
print bw_3db

quit
.endc
